copy.evidence_lead: Every frame is a screenshot from one of three real Minecraft clients playing the production jar on the loader's real dedicated server, taken by a check that passed, and bound to its exact commit, loader and Actions run.
copy.gallery_lead: What three real players saw on a dedicated server, for every Minecraft version and loader: one player disables a spawner for herself and the players near her, while it stays active for everyone else.
methodology: For every lane, scripts/e2e/multiplayer.py starts the loader's dedicated server with the production jar and three real clients of the same loader, each on its own virtual display.
The players act through real mouse and keyboard input; the server is only set up over RCON (placing the test spawners, teleporting players to look at them, reading block data).
Each capture is published only when its check passed: the share of the mod's golden active texture around the crosshair, the chat, or the block the server reports.
Each capture is bound to its exact commit, tested run, loader and production JAR digest.
Publication is advisory; the repository's build and multiplayer gates remain authoritative.
principles: Every image comes from a real packaged mod JAR.
Every release is bound to an exact current branch head.
